**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the pain point — especially if an AI agent caused it.

**Proposed feature**
What should unlose do?

**Alternatives considered**
What else did you try (other tools, manual backups, DIY scripts)?

**Notes**
- ⚠️ unlose deliberately does NOT do command interception/blocking — feature requests in that direction will be closed (see README "We deliberately do NOT")
- Feature requests for the future **Enterprise** tier (centralized management, compliance audit, private deployment) are collected separately — mark your request with `[Enterprise]` in the title if applicable
